mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS totalPv, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0) AS totalUv, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0)), 0), 1) AS averageDurationSeconds FROM grap_pack_visitor WHERE
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS todayPv, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0) AS todayUv FROM grap_pack_visitor WHERE

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(visited_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS pv, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0) AS uv FROM grap_pack_visitor WHERE GROUP BY DATE(visited_at) ORDER BY DATE(visited_at) ASC

SELECT service_code AS serviceCode, menu_code AS menuCode, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS pv, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0) AS uv, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0)), 0), 1) AS averageDurationSeconds, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN device_type = 'MOBILE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0 ), 1 ) AS mobileRatio FROM grap_pack_visitor WHERE GROUP BY service_code, menu_code ORDER BY pv DESC, uv DESC, service_code ASC, menu_code ASC

SELECT route_key AS routeKey, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS pv, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0) AS uv, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0)), 0), 1) AS averageDurationSeconds FROM grap_pack_visitor WHERE GROUP BY route_key ORDER BY pv DESC, uv DESC, route_key ASC
SELECT device_type AS deviceType, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS pv FROM grap_pack_visitor WHERE GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY FIELD(device_type, 'DESKTOP', 'MOBILE', 'TABLET', 'BOT', 'UNKNOWN')
